summary: This trace reveals a new healthcare/pharmacy inventory coverage analysis variant with different sheet names, column structures, and data quality patterns (deduplication by Transfer ID, Confirmed/Tentative/Cancelled status filtering). The task succeeded by using pandas for data extraction and filtering, then openpyxl for precise output formatting. The existing supply-chain-coverage-analysis skill covers similar calculations but is optimized for rack/lane logistics with different source data structures. This patch adds a new 'branch-inventory-coverage' skill that captures the clinic/healthcare variant with its specific deduplication logic, composite key handling (Branch+Item), transfer status filtering, and pandas-first workflow.
